question: Pulmonary fibrosis is a complication of: March 2011, March 2012, September 2012, March 2013
analysis: Pulmonary fibrosis is a known complication of several drugs, particularly those used in chemotherapy. Among the options provided, Busulfan is most commonly associated with pulmonary fibrosis. Methotrexate can also cause pulmonary toxicity, but Busulfan is more classically linked to this specific complication.
